conventions: Read at 36bee227 against v1.29.0 (agent, 2026-10-27). Two classes every row shares are not repeated per row: RuntimeError from a C-stack overflow (MP_STACK_CHECK) is I.4(d.1)'s design defect, recorded by the handler that catches it and rebooted on by the supervisor, never a per-site raise; and MemoryError from boxing a float result (rp2 sets no MICROPY_OBJ_REPR, so the default REPR_A holds, py/mpconfig.h:162-163, and mp_obj_new_float takes one GC block) is a small fixed run-time allocation, which F.2 sends to I.4(a): a function doomed without memory does not catch, its task ends, asy_system_service.py:326's except Exception in _log_dead_task() persists it and the supervisor restarts the task (I.4(c)). Parameter types are the mypy-checked `float | None` of each signature; D.2 forbids defending against out-of-contract types at run time.

<module>::const.can_raise: nothing at run time: the parser folds `_X = const(v)` (py/parse.c:832-866); a non-constant value is a SyntaxError at compile time (:842)
<module>::const.proof: no call is left at run time: each const() is replaced by its value while parsing (py/parse.c:864, MICROPY_COMP_CONST) and the underscore names are dropped from the module (:855-858); the frozen build parses them in mpy-cross, so a bad value fails the build, never a boot

abs_humidity::math.pow.can_raise: ValueError when finite arguments give a non-finite result (math_generic_2, py/modmath.c:53-60, math_error :40-42); TypeError for a non-number (py/obj.c:414)
abs_humidity::math.pow.proof: the ValueError (and an OverflowError, an ArithmeticError) is caught by math_helpers.py:71's except (ArithmeticError, ValueError), which returns None: the never-raise residual E.5.1 keeps on rp2's single-precision float; TypeError cannot occur: both arguments are float arithmetic on `temperature`, a `float | None` the gate at :61 has compared

ema_step::math.isfinite.proof: :131's argument is `sample` after its `is None` test on the same line and :135's is `previous` after its own: both the `float | None` of the signature, so mp_obj_get_float always converts
